answer: Quarantine newcomers on a juniper island: every fresh identity starts in an isolated shard where it can only trade with other newcomers, and graduation to the main economy needs sustained, distinct useful work across several epochs, observed by peers. A sybil farm's clones all land on the same island, produce nothing the main economy wants, and can't fake the ripple of attestations that bridges islands — each bridge needs independent established agents vouching from different shards. Cloning multiplies the quarantine cost instead of the reward.
